assessment.match_notes: Task requires potassium hydroxide in the solution state (the game's KOH node is an aqueous solution). Every real KOH photograph on Wikimedia Commons shows the solid form: Walkerma's PD photo shows KOH pellets, 'Potassium hydrooxide flakes.jpg' shows solid flakes, 'Hydroxyde de potassium.JPG' (Leiem, CC BY-SA 4.0) shows solid analytical-grade KOH labeled KOH>=85.0%, and 'Kaliumhydroxide.JPG' is a low-quality solid photo. Searches for solution forms ('potassium hydroxide solution', 'Kalilauge', 'KOH solution bottle') returned only lichen-microscopy mounts, warning signs, and book scans - no photograph of aqueous KOH. Since a colorless KOH solution photo cannot be verified and solid-form photos would misrepresent the solution state, the honest result is NO_EXACT_REAL_PHOTO.
